scope: Mechanism study on the frozen 12-task teacher development set; no independent paired model comparison.

cases.notes: Literal search already supplied the observed caller; the repair came from the named target and the documented contract.

Official controls are valid (empty fails, gold passes), but the public statement does not name the new API, and the four plausible names (random_product, random_permutation, random_combination, random_combination_with_replacement) already exist in more_itertools/recipes.py as single-draw recipes. A teacher patch would have to guess the exported names and the iteration semantics; deferred rather than graded, and this is recorded as a statement-specification limit of a terse task.

Graph surfaced the existing TestSerialize reference on the unpatched source. The patch privatised _iterator/_lock and forwarded send/throw/close under the same lock; the official verifier accepted it.
after_log applied the seconds format to the callback name and printed the raw seconds; the one-function graph query added nothing. Official verifier accepted the swap.

enabled=False on the direct-call path; the teacher patch is frozen and passes local smoke, but the official sandbox could not build the checkout (hatch-vcs needs .git, then the venv had no pip). Recorded as a harness limitation, not a teacher failure.

teacher_patch_policy: No reference or test patch was read before freezing any patch; case 3 controls were run after the teacher opened the source and that deviation is recorded.
